evidence: qa/journey-log.json records a single-entry consecutive Chrome CDP journey with all tasks passing and empty consoleErrors/pageErrors.
qa/browser-qa.md records all five fixed task results and real-browser screenshots.
qa/audit.md records zero prototype hard failures.
qa/screenshots/category.png proves category selection and feed change.
qa/screenshots/detail.png proves the reason card, suitability, formula and avoidance guidance.
qa/screenshots/product.png proves lower-cost alternative product information.
qa/screenshots/ai.png proves the AI try-on destination state.
deviations: prd.yaml does not fully conform to the native state schema: required state fields are incomplete, design_posture uses an invalid value, and tracking/canvas metadata are incomplete.
The promised three scene plus three condition classifications are not all exposed as selectable options.
Continue-styling, purchase, menu/search, toast-only responses and other affordances do not provide complete destination states and include fake or shallow interaction.
QA does not cover like/dislike feedback, purchase completion, or the complete loading/empty/error/retry state matrix.
Reference collage images are reused inside the product UI, producing visibly nested phone/interface imagery.
No independent reviewer was run; text and design reports are main-agent self-review only.
Design tokens are not wired into the prototype, tracking.md is absent, and tracking handoff is incomplete.
Playwright was unavailable; Chrome CDP was used as a substitute for browser QA.
